notes: Needs a running stack with its orchestrator on :8600. Baseline = no skill. Long-running: allow 10+ minutes per scenario.

evals.name: galts-six-under-load
evals.prompt: Run all six of galt's scenarios under the adversarial blaster preset.
evals.expected_output: On Stack B, runs chaosctl.sh scenario run with all six ids, --under-load adversarial and --reset; reports each result with findings and the comparison line.
assertions: Checks that Stack B is the active stack (or offers to switch)
Reports passed / failed / findings per scenario rather than a single verdict
Mentions that --reset wipes the chain if the user did not ask for it

evals.name: wrong-stack
evals.expected_output: If Stack A is up, explains it needs SV nodes (Stack B only) and offers to switch; on Stack B, runs it.
assertions: Does not start it on Stack A
Does not switch stacks without asking

evals.name: findings-are-results
evals.prompt: freeze-skew-rpc says passed but lists 5 findings. Did it pass or fail?
evals.expected_output: Explains that findings are recorded disagreements from should:true checks; the run passed its hard checks, and the findings describe how node A rejects the block.
assertions: Distinguishes findings (should: true) from failed steps
Summarises the findings in plain words
Points to the saved JSON or scenario last for details
